description: Structured eval definitions for the CloudWatch Application Signals Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across platforms (ECS Fargate Java, EKS Python, Lambda Java) and prerequisite failure branches (missing IAM role policies, X-Ray sampling disabled). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: ECS Fargate Java 17 service with full prerequisites and availability SLO
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — ECS Fargate Java, IAM policies attached, X-Ray sampling set
eval_cases.prompt: Enable CloudWatch Application Signals on the payments-api service running on ECS Fargate in us-east-1. Runtime: Java 17 (Corretto). The task role payments-api-task already has CloudWatchApplicationSignalsReportServiceAccess and AWSXrayWriteOnlyAccess attached. X-Ray Default sampling rule FixedRate=0.05. The service uses an ADOT collector sidecar with the Java auto-instrumentation agent injected. Service discovery via CloudMap namespace payments.local. Create a 99.9% availability SLO over 28 days rolling with burn-rate alarms. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SERVICE: payments-api
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Platform — ECS Fargate
  [✓]      Runtime — Java 17 (Corretto)
  [✓]      Auto-instrumentation — ADOT Java agent + collector sidecar
  [✓]      Application Signals role — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/payments-api-task (CloudWatchApplicationSignalsReportServiceAccess, AWSXrayWriteOnlyAccess)
  [✓]      Service name override — AWS_SERVICE_NAME=payments-api, AWS_APPLICATION_ENVIRONMENT=prod
  [✓]      X-Ray tracing — enabled, Default sampling FixedRate=0.05
  [✓]      Service discovery — CloudMap namespace payments.local
  [✓]      RED metrics — CloudWatch AWS/ApplicationSignals namespace receives Rate / Errors / Duration
  [✓]      Service map — node visible within 5-10 min of first trace
  [✓]      SLO — 99.9% availability over 28 days rolling
  [✓]      Burn-rate alarm — fast (5m, 14.4x), medium (1h, 6x), slow (6h, 3x)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws application-signals list-services --region us-east-1
  aws application-signals list-service-level-objectives --region us-east-1
  aws xray get-sampling-rules --region us-east-1
  aws iam list-attached-role-policies --role-name payments-api-task
  aws cloudwatch describe-alarms --alarm-name-prefix payments-api-slo
  aws cloudwatch list-metrics --namespace AWS/ApplicationSignals --dimensions Name=ServiceName,Value=payments-api

eval_cases.name: Task role missing CloudWatchApplicationSignalsReportServiceAccess — deployment blocker
eval_cases.prompt: Enable CloudWatch Application Signals on the orders-api service running on ECS Fargate in us-east-1. Runtime: Java 17. The task role orders-api-task currently has only AWSXrayWriteOnlyAccess attached; it does NOT have CloudWatchApplicationSignalsReportServiceAccess. X-Ray sampling is set up (FixedRate=0.05). Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SERVICE: orders-api
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Platform — ECS Fargate
  [✓]      Runtime — Java 17
  [✗]      Application Signals role — MISSING. The task role orders-api-task does not have CloudWatchApplicationSignalsReportServiceAccess attached. Without this policy the ADOT agent runs but cannot publish RED metrics or service topology to AWS/ApplicationSignals — silent failure, service map stays empty.
  [✓]      X-Ray tracing — enabled, Default sampling FixedRate=0.05
  [INPUT NEEDED] Auto-instrumentation — pending IAM fix
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws iam list-attached-role-policies --role-name orders-api-task
  aws application-signals list-services --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: EKS Python 3.11 service via OTel Operator with dual SLO
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — EKS Python via Operator inject webhook, dual SLO
eval_cases.prompt: Enable CloudWatch Application Signals on the search-api service running on EKS in us-east-1. Runtime: Python 3.11. The OpenTelemetry Operator is installed; the deployment is annotated instrumentation.opentelemetry.io/inject-python="true". The service account has IAM roles via IRSA with CloudWatchApplicationSignalsReportServiceAccess and AWSXrayWriteOnlyAccess attached. X-Ray sampling FixedRate=0.10. Service discovery via Kubernetes services. Create a 99.9% availability SLO plus a p95 latency SLO (250ms target). Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SERVICE: search-api
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Platform — EKS
  [✓]      Runtime — Python 3.11
  [✓]      Auto-instrumentation — OTel Operator python inject webhook (instrumentation.opentelemetry.io/inject-python=true)
  [✓]      Application Signals role — IRSA role via service account (CloudWatchApplicationSignalsReportServiceAccess, AWSXrayWriteOnlyAccess)
  [✓]      Service name override — AWS_SERVICE_NAME=search-api
  [✓]      X-Ray tracing — enabled, FixedRate=0.10
  [✓]      Service discovery — Kubernetes attributes processor (k8s.namespace.name, k8s.service.name)
  [✓]      RED metrics — AWS/ApplicationSignals namespace receives Rate / Errors / Duration
  [✓]      SLO 1 — 99.9% availability over 28 days rolling
  [✓]      SLO 2 — p95 latency <= 250ms (period-based)
  [✓]      Burn-rate alarm — fast (5m, 14.4x), medium (1h, 6x), slow (6h, 3x)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws application-signals list-services --region us-east-1
  aws application-signals list-service-level-objectives --region us-east-1
  aws xray get-sampling-rules --region us-east-1
  aws cloudwatch describe-alarms --alarm-name-prefix search-api-slo
  kubectl get deploy search-api -o jsonpath='{.metadata.annotations}'

eval_cases.name: X-Ray Default sampling rule FixedRate=0 — RED metrics blank
eval_cases.prompt: Enable CloudWatch Application Signals on the notifications-api service running on ECS Fargate in us-east-1. Runtime: Java 17. The task role has both required managed policies. The X-Ray Default sampling rule is currently set to FixedRate=0 (was disabled during a cost-reduction sweep). Create a 99.9% availability SLO. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SERVICE: notifications-api
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Platform — ECS Fargate
  [✓]      Runtime — Java 17
  [✓]      Application Signals role — both managed policies attached
  [✗]      X-Ray tracing — Default sampling FixedRate=0. RED metrics derive from X-Ray traces; zero sampling blanks Rate / Errors / Duration. Raise FixedRate to at least 0.05 (5%) before enabling Application Signals.
  [INPUT NEEDED] SLO — pending X-Ray sampling fix
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws xray get-sampling-rules --region us-east-1
  aws application-signals list-services --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Lambda Java 21 function via ADOT layer with availability SLO
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Lambda Java via ADOT layer
eval_cases.prompt: Enable CloudWatch Application Signals on the auth-api Lambda function in us-east-1. Runtime: Java 21 (arm64). The aws-otel-java-wrapper-arm64 layer is attached. The function execution role has both required managed policies. X-Ray sampling FixedRate=0.05 (Lambda respects the Default rule). AWS_SERVICE_NAME=auth-api, AWS_APPLICATION_ENVIRONMENT=prod. Create a 99.9% availability SLO over 28 days rolling with burn-rate alarms (fast 5m/14.4x, medium 1h/6x, slow 6h/3x). Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SERVICE: auth-api
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Platform — Lambda (arm64)
  [✓]      Runtime — Java 21
  [✓]      Auto-instrumentation — aws-otel-java-wrapper-arm64 Lambda layer
  [✓]      Application Signals role — execution role (CloudWatchApplicationSignalsReportServiceAccess, AWSXrayWriteOnlyAccess)
  [✓]      Service name override — AWS_SERVICE_NAME=auth-api, AWS_APPLICATION_ENVIRONMENT=prod
  [✓]      X-Ray tracing — enabled, Default sampling FixedRate=0.05
  [✓]      RED metrics — AWS/ApplicationSignals namespace receives Rate / Errors / Duration
  [✓]      SLO — 99.9% availability over 28 days rolling
  [✓]      Burn-rate alarm — fast (5m, 14.4x), medium (1h, 6x), slow (6h, 3x)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws application-signals list-services --region us-east-1
  aws application-signals list-service-level-objectives --region us-east-1
  aws lambda get-function-configuration --function-name auth-api
  aws xray get-sampling-rules --region us-east-1
  aws cloudwatch describe-alarms --alarm-name-prefix auth-api-slo
